title: jmap: push KeyPackage state changes (claim, create, destroy) through EventSource
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §Handing Out KeyPackages: a destroyed (handed-out) record appears in a new KeyPackage state 'so a client that receives the StateChange can replenish'. mimid-1wgh.12.3 gives KeyPackage/get and /set with a digest state but no push: the follower's claim path (KeyPackages::serve_key_material via Store::claim_key_packages) does not reach the ChangeBus, and EventSource only knows Chat, Message and ChatContact. Work: a KeyPackage change channel from KeyPackages (claim, upload, delete) into the bus as Change::KeyPackages{user_uri}; EventSource computes the KeyPackage state for 'KeyPackage' in types; a test that a keyMaterial claim pushes a state event.
close_reason: KeyPackage state pushed on create/destroy/claim; tested
